body: Climb to the temple and look over the city, sông Lam, and Hồng Lĩnh. The temple is on the second summit, 92 m above the sea. The 1 October 1788 edict sited Phượng Hoàng Trung Đô here. That capital was started and not finished. The roof is the courtyard. The river is the view from the hill.

The temple stood in phường Trung Đô. Trung Đô is now inside phường Trường Vinh. The two large days are the death anniversary on the 29th of the 7th lunar month and the Ngọc Hồi–Đống Đa anniversary on the 5th of the 1st lunar month. The solar date changes with the year.

This hill is in the city. Kim Liên is another commune, 15 km out, and also 13 km by Quốc lộ 46. Do not send this visit there. A fee, an opening hour, and the minutes from the square are check on arrival.
